title: Claude - Issues with Google Play subscriptions
text:
Service: Claude
Incident: Issues with Google Play subscriptions
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2026-09-16T16:18:10.728Z
Resolved: 2026-09-16T16:51:09.019Z
Updates:
- 2026-09-16T16:51:09.019Z: resolved - This issue has been resolved.
- 2026-09-16T16:18:10.776Z: identified - We are aware of an issue affecting users interacting with subscriptions via Google Play, such as when creating a new subscription on Android devices. Google has confirmed an issue with Google Play, and we are awaiting their further updates.

incident_updates.body: We are aware of an issue affecting users interacting with subscriptions via Google Play, such as when creating a new subscription on Android devices. Google has confirmed an issue with Google Play, and we are awaiting their further updates.
